title: Sunlit Shallows
scene: Barefoot beach walk — Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro
youtube_title: Sunlit Shallows — DJ Velvet Grey | Melodic Chill House
description:
Picture yourself walking barefoot along Copacabana at golden hour, warm water at your ankles, Sugarloaf Mountain glowing across the bay and nowhere you need to be.
A bright, breezy melodic house groove for slow beach days and sunny drives.
